senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.7.3 candrakāntaḥ चन्द्रकान्तः
Moon stone
Moon stone is sodium potassium aluminium silicate of feldspar with a pearly appearance. Duly processed chandrakanta is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-9.6.80 candramaṇḍalavatchedaḥ चन्द्रमण्डलवत्-छेदः
Circular incision
An incision made in the shape of a circle.
